name: pass-strength-dotted-indicator
blurb: Password input with 5 dots that fill based on strength score and requirements.
description: A password form with a visual 5-dot strength indicator that fills and changes color progressively, combined with a requirements checklist using check/cross icons.
use_when: Building registration or password forms where visual dot-based strength feedback is preferred.
avoid_when: When strength bars are needed or when space for the dots is unavailable.
a11y: Password input is properly labeled, show/hide button has aria-label, requirements list has aria-label, strength status linked via aria-describedby.
